data.narrative:
Skyroot Aerospace is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $160M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers, with particular focus on 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies: Sierra Space ($8.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.5B), and Skyryse ($1.1B).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $160M raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $272M. Peer-median valuation across the 3 same-stage comparables produces $1.5B, though the range spans $1.1B to $8.0B, reflecting material dispersion in the peer set. Public-comp anchoring (P/S median of 26.4x across the 5 traded peers) cannot be applied due to absence of revenue data for the target.

The two applicable methods produce a triangulated range of $231M (low) to $1.7B (high), with a median of $886M. The wide spread reflects genuine uncertainty in this sector: stage-progression suggests a more conservative $272M valuation, while peer median anchors toward $1.5B. Key uncertainties include the target's revenue trajectory, capital efficiency relative to peers, and whether Sierra Space's $8B valuation represents a meaningful benchmark or an outlier within the peer set.
